challenges.name: validate-order-payload
challenges.title: Validate the order JSON from the mobile app
challenges.description: Orders reach Hồ Gươm Books as JSON from the mobile app. A request cut off by a bad connection became an empty order, a quantity of "1 cuốn" silently dropped a book, and giftWrap: "false" gift-wrapped a parcel. Write validateOrder: decode with JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR, check that the body is an object, validate the email with filter_var and the phone with a regular expression, require a non-empty list of items with a sku and an integer quantity from 1 to 10, and accept giftWrap only as a real boolean. Return every problem, in order. The test runner prints ok or the list of problems.

tests.name: The starter example: a phone number sent as a JSON number and no items
tests.expected: invalid: phone must be 10 digits starting with 0; items must be a non-empty list

tests.name: A request cut off by a bad connection
A JSON list instead of an object
tests.expected: invalid: order must be an object

tests.name: Quantities that are not integers from 1 to 10, and broken items
tests.expected: invalid: item 1: qty must be a whole number from 1 to 10; item 2: sku is missing; item 2: qty must be a whole number from 1 to 10; item 3: sku is missing; item 3: qty must be a whole number from 1 to 10; item 4 must be an object; item 5: qty must be a whole number from 1 to 10; item 6: qty must be a whole number from 1 to 10

tests.name: A display name in the email and giftWrap sent as a string
tests.expected: invalid: email is not valid; phone must be 10 digits starting with 0; giftWrap must be true or false

tests.name: An email with a leading space and an item without a sku
tests.expected: invalid: email is not valid; item 1: sku is missing

tests.name: A gift order with ten copies
